proposals.before: Empress Wang of Heir Apparent Taizong bore Lamented Crown Prince Daqi and Prince of Nan commandery Dalian; Lady Chen the Shure bore Prince of Xunyang Daxin; the left lady bore Princes Dalin of Nanhai and Dachun of Anlu; Lady Xie bore Duke of Liuyang Daya; Lady Zhang bore Prince of Xinxing Dazhuang; Bao Zhaohua bore Prince of Xiyang Dajun; Lady Fan bore Prince of Wuning Dawei; Chu Xiuhua bore Prince of Jianping Daqiu; Lady Chen bore Prince of Yi'an Daxin; Lady Zhu bore Prince of Suijian Dazhi.
proposals.after: Empress Wang of Heir Apparent Taizong bore Lamented Crown Prince Daqi and Prince of Nan commandery Dalian; Lady Chen the Shurong bore Prince of Xunyang Daxin (大心); the Left Lady bore Prince Dalin of Nanhai and Prince Dachun of Anlu; Lady Xie bore Duke of Liuyang Daya; Lady Zhang bore Prince of Xinxing Dazhuang; Bao Zhaohua bore Prince of Xiyang Dajun; Lady Fan bore Prince of Wuning Dawei; Chu Xiuhua bore Prince of Jianping Daqiu; Lady Chen bore Prince of Yi'an Daxin (大昕); Lady Zhu bore Prince of Suijian Dazhi.
proposals.reason: 淑容 romanized as "Shure" is a clear error for Shurong; 大心 and 大昕 are distinct names both rendered Daxin without disambiguation.

proposals.before: In the third year the city fell; Senior Armor Xiao Shao fled south and proclaimed a secret edict making Daxin regular palace attendant and General Who Pacifies the South.
proposals.after: In the third year the city fell; Marquis of Shangjia Xiao Shao fled south and proclaimed a secret edict making Daxin regular palace attendant and General Who Pacifies the South.
proposals.reason: 上甲侯 is the noble title Marquis of Shangjia, not "Senior Armor".

proposals.before: In the third year the city fell; Senior Armor Xiao Shao fled south and proclaimed a secret edict adding Daxin as regular palace attendant and promoting his title to General Who Pacifies the South.
proposals.after: In the third year the city fell; Marquis of Shangjia Xiao Shao fled south and proclaimed a secret edict adding Daxin as regular palace attendant and promoting his title to General Who Pacifies the South.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 上甲侯 as "Senior Armor" in the literal field.

proposals.before: In the third year Kuaiji bandits led by Tian Ling gathered tens of thousands and attacked; Dalian ordered middle army aide Zhang Biao to strike and behead them.
proposals.after: In the third year Kuaiji bandits led by Tian Lingqun gathered tens of thousands and attacked; Dalian ordered middle army aide Zhang Biao to strike and behead them.
proposals.reason: 田領群 is a three-character personal name; dropping 群 loses the given name.

proposals.before: His birth mother is not recorded in this book; he has a separate biography.)〉
proposals.after: (His birth mother is not recorded in this book; he has a separate biography.)
proposals.reason: Orphaned closing parenthesis and CJK corner bracket 〉 corrupt the English gloss of the interlinear note.

proposals.before: In the second year, he went out as General Who Pacifies the Distant and administrator of Langye and Pengcheng commanderies, but before reaching his post he was killed, aged eleven.
proposals.after: In the second year, he went out as General of Peaceful Distance and administrator of Langye and Pengcheng commanderies, but before reaching his post he was killed, aged eleven.
proposals.reason: 寧遠將軍 is elsewhere "General of Peaceful Distance"; "Pacifies the Distant" invents a wrong sense of 寧遠.

decisions.after: Empress Wang of Heir Apparent Taizong bore Lamented Crown Prince Daqi and Prince of Nan commandery Dalian; Lady Chen the Shurong bore Prince of Xunyang Daxin; the Left Lady bore Prince Dalin of Nanhai and Prince Dachun of Anlu; Lady Xie bore Duke of Liuyang Daya; Lady Zhang bore Prince of Xinxing Dazhuang; Bao Zhaohua bore Prince of Xiyang Dajun; Lady Fan bore Prince of Wuning Dawei; Chu Xiuhua bore Prince of Jianping Daqiu; Lady Chen bore Prince of Yi'an Daxin; Lady Zhu bore Prince of Suijian Dazhi.
decisions.reason: s0003 has 陳淑容 (Shurong), not 'Shure,' and lists distinct sons 尋陽王大心 and 義安王大昕. Keeping each shared romanization attached to the prince's territorial title distinguishes them naturally in English.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 陳淑容生尋陽王大心……陳夫人生義安王大昕

decisions.reason: s0015 names 上甲侯蕭韶; 上甲侯 is the marquisate title Marquis of Shangjia, so “Senior Armor” is a false calque and the proposed replacement matches the Chinese.
The same 上甲侯蕭韶 appears in the literal field of s0015; replacing “Senior Armor” with “Marquis of Shangjia” corrects the title without changing the rest of the sentence.
s0066 names the bandit leader 田領群; truncating to “Tian Ling” drops 群 from the given name, and “Tian Lingqun” restores the full personal name.

s0125 is the interlinear note 〈（本書不載所生，別有傳）〉; the idiomatic English left an orphan “)〉”, and wrapping the gloss in matching parentheses removes the corrupted CJK bracket without changing the note’s meaning.

s0189 assigns 寧遠將軍; the same title is already rendered “General of Peaceful Distance” in s0123, whereas “General Who Pacifies the Distant” misreads 寧 as “pacify,” so aligning the idiomatic gloss corrects the sense.
